sources.coordinate_system: absolute source pixels, x right, y down, bbox max exclusive
sources.order: Row major for source identity only; actual pose bounds explicitly measured. C2 push-off extends beyond the former x=887 grid line.
sources.root_contract: Grounded stages 0/5/6/7 use actual local support-line proxies. Airborne stages 1/2/3/4 use local virtual standing-foot proxies estimated beneath the pelvis with legs extended. C2 push-off root is explicitly recalibrated to [701,446]. Source roots remove sheet-layout offsets when aligning to anchor; source row or hair-height differences are never added as jump movement.
sources.height_contract: Independent OUTPUT heights for source stages 0..7 are [0,8,50,80,50,0,0,0]. separate_height preview applies height_px to the entire normalized PNG once. Do not also apply source root_y/row differences, and do not normalize every airborne pose by the lowest foot.
sources.foot_contract: foot is one actual visible lower boot-sole point for overlay review; it is not the root estimator for airborne poses.
sources.timing_contract: jump_demo uses source stages 1..7, [3,6,5,6,2,5,5] = 32 ticks. It starts with push-off immediately; the 6-tick preparation pose is an optional separate jump_prepare clip and is not a mandatory input delay. Phase clips reuse the same 8 source IDs. Runtime phase changes follow physics, not these demo holds.
sources.alpha_observation: C2 is actual transparent RGBA (alpha 0..255). At alpha>24 it has exactly 8 substantial components. Faint lower-alpha speckles remain outside major shapes; allow_edge_alpha=true is explicit draft acceptance of those existing remnants, not final alpha cleanup. Source image unchanged.
sources.bbox_contract: Every bbox includes complete visible actor, sword and scabbard with padding around the substantial alpha component. No source pixel processing was performed.
visual_limitations: C2 fixes the major missing leg extension in push-off, but does not prove timing or force quality until playback is reviewed.
Push-off source silhouette is taller after extension; shared standing_height=400 is retained and any proportional drift requires comparison, not individual resizing.
Sword angles remain similar in airborne poses; fingers, hand-to-hilt contact and off-hand balance need review at final size.
Prepare and compression remain combat crouches; compression reaches the off hand toward the floor.
Recovery still has flexed knees and a wide combat stance; a neutral standing transition is missing.
Manual source roots have +/-10 pixels estimated uncertainty, +/-15 for edited push-off. No art approval or runtime timing approval claimed.
sources.verification: Viewed C2 original; measured its 8 alpha>24 components; explicit bboxes, coordinates and JSON checked. No exporter invocation or output PNG/GIF/manifest generation performed.

calibration_notes.jump: height curve is preview only; physical runtime jump remains variable; no preparation delay baked
calibration_notes.jump_alpha: Jump uses manually separated full crops; alpha speckles retained. Attack1/run use explicit component masks where adjacent rectangular crops overlap.
